title: Choose the experience
body: Compare the route and the pace. A full highland day, a sunset excursion and a night-sky session serve different interests.

title: Read the inclusions
body: Check reserve entry, meals, guide language and pickup coverage. The cheapest starting price may exclude costs you still need to pay.

title: Fit the departure
body: Leave room for arrival, meals, rest and altitude. Confirm the return point before joining two separately booked activities.

title: Reserve your option
body: Choose the date and party size on GetYourGuide. Read the selected option’s conditions and save the operator confirmation.
